title: Vin Diesel Says ‘Fast Forever’ Has the ‘Best Script I Have Read in Decades’: ‘I Am Still Crying’
content:
Diesel also teased a connection to the original 'The Fast and the Furious' film.

ByMatt Minton

mminton@variety.com

Vin Dieselhas read the script for the 11th “Fast & Furious” film, and he is singing its praises.

“I just read the ‘Fast Forever‘ script by [Michael Lesslie]. It is the best script I have read in decades,” Dieselwrote on Instagram. “I am still crying…”

The post was shared alongside a trailer for the upcoming re-release of the original “The Fast and the Furious” film, which is coming back to theaters on Aug. 21 in time for its 25th anniversary. That film starred Diesel alongside the late Paul Walker, Michelle Rodriguez, Jordana Brewster, Rick Yue and Chad Lindberg, kicking off the long-running action franchise after grossing $207 million worldwide (not adjusted for inflation).

In his Instagram post, Diesel also teased that “Fast Forever” will have a tie to the original film: “You will thank God you got to see the First one in the theaters this summer.”

“Fast Forever” is the latest film in the action franchise after “Fast X,” which was released in May 2023 and grossed $704 million worldwide. It left things off on a big cliffhanger, teasing Gal Gadot and Dwayne Johnson’s returns with two post-credit scenes. “Fast Forever” will be directed by Louis Leterrier, known for “The Transporter” and “The Incredible Hulk.”

Lesslie was announced to be writing the scriptback in March. Sources toldVarietythat he rewrote a script previously penned by Aaron Rabin and Zach Dean. Lesslie has written “The Hunger Games: The Ballad of Songbirds and Snakes,” “Macbeth,” “Assassin’s Creed,” “Now You See Me: Now You Don’t” and “Hamlet” starring Riz Ahmed. He also penned the screenplay for “Sunrise on the Reaping,” which will hit  theaters on November 20, in addition to executive producing both “The Rescue” and “Thirteen Lives.”

“Fast Forever” will release in theaters March 17, 2028.
title_zh: 范·迪塞爾(Vin Diesel)表示《速度與激情：永恆(Fast Forever)》擁有「我這幾十年來讀過的最佳劇本」： 「我仍然在哭泣」。
content_zh:
范·迪塞爾(Vin Diesel)也暗示了與原版《速度與激情》(The Fast and the Furious)電影的聯繫。

文／馬特·敏頓(Matt Minton)

mminton@variety.com

范·迪塞爾(Vin Diesel)已經閱讀了第11部《速度與激情》(Fast & Furious)電影的劇本，他對此讚不絕口。

“我剛剛讀了[邁克爾·萊斯利(Michael Lesslie)]的《永恆的速度》(Fast Forever)劇本。這是我幾十年來讀過的最佳劇本，”迪塞爾在Instagram上寫道。“我仍然在哭…”

這則帖子與即將重新上映的原版《速度與激情》(The Fast and the Furious)電影的預告片一起分享，該片將於8月21日回到影院，恰逢其25週年紀念。這部電影由迪塞爾與已故的保羅·沃克(Paul Walker)、米歇爾·羅德里格茲(Michelle Rodriguez)、喬丹娜·布魯斯特(Jordana Brewster)、瑞克·余(Rick Yue)和查德·林德伯格(Chad Lindberg)共同主演，全球票房達到2.07億美元（未調整通脹）。

在他的Instagram帖子中，迪塞爾還暗示《永恆的速度》將與原版電影有聯繫：“你會感謝上帝，你在這個夏天能在影院看到第一部。”

《永恆的速度》是這個動作系列的最新作品，接續《速度與激情X》(Fast X)，該片於2023年5月上映，全球票房達到7.04億美元。該片以一個懸念結尾，暗示蓋爾·加朵(Gal Gadot)和道恩·強森(Dwayne Johnson)的回歸，並有兩個片尾彩蛋。《永恆的速度》將由路易斯·雷特里耶(Louis Leterrier)執導，他以《運輸者》(The Transporter)和《無敵浩克》(The Incredible Hulk)而聞名。

萊斯利(Michael Lesslie)在3月被宣布負責劇本創作。消息人士告訴《綜藝》(Variety)，他重寫了之前由亞倫·拉賓(Aaron Rabin)和扎克·迪恩(Zach Dean)撰寫的劇本。萊斯利還創作了《飢餓遊戲：歌鴿與蛇的傳說》(The Hunger Games: The Ballad of Songbirds and Snakes)、《麥克白》(Macbeth)、《刺客信條》(Assassin’s Creed)、《看不見的你》(Now You See Me: Now You Don’t)和主演瑞茲·艾哈邁德(Riz Ahmed)的《哈姆雷特》(Hamlet)。他還撰寫了《收割的日出》(Sunrise on the Reaping)的劇本，該片將於11月20日上映，並擔任《救援》(The Rescue)和《十三條命》(Thirteen Lives)的執行製片人。

《永恆的速度》將於2028年3月17日在影院上映。
